item.title: Editorial: Asylum seekers should be allowed to work while applications are processed
item.description: The Donald Trump administration last week announced an indefinite halt to the issuance of work permits for people who are seeking asylum in this country. In addition to the pause, which the administration says could be “for an extended period, possibly many years,” it also plans to extend the waiting period before permits would be issued from 150 days to 365 days after immigrants apply for asylum.
